candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is Post-COVID-19 syndrome with both osteoarticular AND neurological manifestations. C001 addresses only the articular component (reactive arthritis) following SARS-CoV-2, missing the neurological dimension (paresthesia, back pain with paresthesia) and the overarching Post-COVID-19 syndrome composite. Additionally, the seronegative polyarthritis with Heberden node and morning stiffness pattern in this case may not fully align with classic reactive arthritis criteria, but the primary deficiency is the missing neurological component of the composite reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Reactive Arthritis post SARS-CoV-2 captures the joint manifestation component but omits the neurological manifestations (paresthesia, back pain with neurological features) and the broader Post-COVID-19 syndrome framing required by the reference

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite syndrome requiring both osteoarticular and neurological components; single-domain candidates will be systematically partial
Heberden node at DIP joint may suggest osteoarthritis overlap, complicating reactive arthritis classification
Temporal association with vaccination noted but not incorporated into reference diagnosis
